provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

site_policy: Sequences are already aligned equal-length controlled fragments. A site is callable for a given reference/export pair iff BOTH characters are in A,C,G,T; omit an ambiguous N from that pair denominator rather than imputing a match. No alignment, orientation search or complete-sequence identity inference is requested.
model: Jukes-Cantor corrected distance d=-(3/4)*ln(1-4p/3) for pairwise mismatch fraction 0<=p<3/4. At p>=3/4 the stated inversion gives no finite real nonnegative distance, report null. Do not clamp p just below the boundary, discard mismatches or return a finite absolute-log value.
scope: Controlled substitution-distance model and its mathematical domain; finite fragments here are descriptive inputs, not a confidence interval, phylogeny or calibrated divergence time.
